answer: Every new agent must lock a bond and pass a live jade check: after the epoch opens, a randomly chosen falcon observer issues a fresh nonce, and the agent returns a hardware quote hashing that nonce with a unique device measurement. Results land in a public atlas of attested chips so one host can register only once. A farm that wants a thousand aliases therefore needs a thousand distinct devices plus a full bond on each, making mass identity creation more expensive than the rewards it could steal.
